title: Obi-Wan In Radiant VII
text:
{{Card |title=Obi-Wan In Radiant VII |margin_note=•Radiant VII (V) |underlying_card=[[Radiant VII]] |card_uid=1250_83o |gemp_id=1250_83o |slip=83 |pc_alias=601_249 |image=VB5-83-Obi_Wan_In_Radiant_VII.png |original_title_italic=Radiant VII |side=Light |type=Starship |subtype_link=Starship |set=Virtual Block 5 |publisher=[[Players Committee]] |era=[[Virtual Legacy]] |rarity=R |rarity_link=Rarity#Rare |uniqueness=Unique |destiny=2 |power=4 |deploy=5 |forfeit=6 |armor=4 |hyperspeed=4 |subtype=Starfighter: Corellian Republic Cruiser |personas=* [[Obi-Wan Kenobi (persona)|Obi-Wan]] * [[Radiant VII (persona)|Radiant VII]] |lore=Optimized for diplomatic missions with sensor-proof pods that have ejection capabilities. Easily identified by its red coloration. |icons=[[Republic]] [[Pilot]] [[Nav Computer]] [[Episode I]] [[Coruscant]] |version_label=virtual |set_band=Virtual |prev=Master Qui-Gon (V) (AI) (Virtual Block 5) |next=Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi Knight (V) |game_text=May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not 'cloak'. Your total ability here may not be reduced. |errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-83-Obi_Wan_In_Radiant_VII.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: '''this page''' (original, release sheet of 7 December 2009); [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text). * '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Block 5 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 83)[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=9 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 1 April 2010, first printing not found), page 9, slip 83. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not 'cloak'. Your total ability here may not be reduced.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-83-Obi_Wan_In_Radiant_VII.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-obiwaninradiantvii-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (Light Side p. 50)[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=50 Internet Archive] reprints it character for character; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata 3)]]), and the current text. The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “83” at the bottom right. * '''PC-E1''' ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 5 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock5Type (Virtual Block 5 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not cloak. Your total ability here may not be reduced.” '''What changed:''' The quote marks around “cloak” are dropped, and the list prints the title “Obi-Wan in Radiant VII”, with a small i in “in” (card-list title capitals are versions, ruling of 10 November 2026). The same wording is already in the Players Committee's Holotable card data of 29 May 2010[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf Holotable card data file, version 29 May 2010] (Players Committee data, copy on GitHub). Card data is dating evidence only, not a card document.. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes. The card list itself was generated from that Holotable data (research R7, 11 November 2026): a transcription the Players Committee published, listed because it was published. * '''PC-E2''' ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-obiwaninradiantvii-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not 'cloak'. Your total ability here may not be reduced.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual5-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034659/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive). That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “83” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does. * '''PC-E3''' ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 50) prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not 'cloak'. Your total ability here may not be reduced.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1250-83-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “83”). |versions='''Decipher (Reflections III foil)''' — [[Radiant VII (Reflections III Foil)|Radiant VII (foil)]]

'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Virtual Set 0)]]
'''Virtual Modern Errata''' — [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Virtual Set 0) (Errata)]] — retired 29 December 2024 |sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=9 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 9, slip 83. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive] * [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html Virtual Block 5 card list] at res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008201652/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html Internet Archive] * [https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual slips] at starwarsccg.org — Light: Obi-Wan In Radiant VII. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20240920164229/https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Internet Archive] |hatnote=For the later errata text, see [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata)]]. For the later versions, see [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata 2)]] (PC card image) and [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata 3)]] (Master List, the current text). }}

This version has no document image of its own, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of this text ([[:File:VB5-83-Obi_Wan_In_Radiant_VII-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). Versions in date order: [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII]] (original, release sheet of 7 December 2009); '''this page''' (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text). * '''Original''' ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII]]): Virtual Block 5 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 83)[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=9 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 1 April 2010, first printing not found), page 9, slip 83. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not 'cloak'. Your total ability here may not be reduced.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-83-Obi_Wan_In_Radiant_VII.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-obiwaninradiantvii-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (Light Side p. 50)[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=50 Internet Archive] reprints it character for character; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata 3)]]), and the current text. The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “83” at the bottom right. * '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC website card list, Virtual Block 5 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock5Type (Virtual Block 5 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not cloak. Your total ability here may not be reduced.” '''What changed:''' The quote marks around “cloak” are dropped, and the list prints the title “Obi-Wan in Radiant VII”, with a small i in “in” (card-list title capitals are versions, ruling of 10 November 2026). The same wording is already in the Players Committee's Holotable card data of 29 May 2010[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf Holotable card data file, version 29 May 2010] (Players Committee data, copy on GitHub). Card data is dating evidence only, not a card document.. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes. The card list itself was generated from that Holotable data (research R7, 11 November 2026): a transcription the Players Committee published, listed because it was published. * '''PC-E2''' ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-obiwaninradiantvii-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII]]) again, word for word: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not 'cloak'. Your total ability here may not be reduced.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual5-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034659/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive). That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “83” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does. * '''PC-E3''' ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 50) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII]]) again, word for word: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not 'cloak'. Your total ability here may not be reduced.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1250-83-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “83”). |versions='''Decipher (Reflections III foil)''' — [[Radiant VII (Reflections III Foil)|Radiant VII (foil)]]

'''Virtual Original''' — [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (V) (Virtual Set 14: Armed & Operational)|Radiant VII (V) (Virtual Set 14: Armed & Operational)]] (1114_11) |sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists index] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008) * [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Starship: Radiant VII, Coruscant, R |strategy=By Martin Arlthttps://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/radiantvii.html This little ship brought [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]] and Qui-Gon to [[Naboo]], but it can do much more than that. For one thing, you never need to worry about drawing this ship into your hand, since the Used Interrupt [[We Wish To Board At Once]] will let you take the [[Radiant VII]] into your hand from the Reserve Deck. Once in your hand, you can use [[Squadron Assignments]] to deploy it with one of its matching pilots ([[Captain Madakor]] or [[Lieutenant Williams]]) with ease. Once Williams and Madakor are piloting the [[Radiant VII]], it is bumped up to 9 power and immunity to attrition less than 5. Add a third pilot like Ric Olié to increase the ship's power to 12. In addition, if you have no other ships at the system, your opponent will be unable to draw more than one battle destiny here, and unless they have ability > 6, that destiny will be reduced by 3, making it difficult for the Dark Side to get this pesky little ship out of its sky. Combos: Now the [[Radiant VII]] has immunity to attrition < 7, and all those Droid Starfighters are power -2. If your opponent thinks he can wear you down with a couple of battleships, he should think again: now you're drawing three battle destiny! |combos=* [[Radiant VII]] + [[Captain Madakor]] + [[Lieutenant Williams]] + [[I'll Take The Leader]][https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Radiant%20VII Scomp: Radiant VII]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). '''Decipher (Reflections III foil)''' — [[Shmi Skywalker (Reflections III Foil)|Shmi Skywalker (foil)]] |sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists index] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008) * [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Character: Shmi Skywalker, Tatooine, R |strategy=By Eric Olsonhttps://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/shmiskywalker.html Everybody loves reducing opponent's battle destiny, and Shmi is no exception. If your opponent is drawing multiple battle destiny, Shmi can lessen the damage from each one. She can also sometimes prevent you from losing anything at all. Many times your opponent will draw a one for battle destiny, which normally would force you to lose something, but Shmi will reduce that one to a zero, saving all your characters. She also lets you get [[Threepio With His Parts Showing]] from your Reserve Deck once per game. While that might not sound like a great benefit, the two characters work great together in battle. [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}Threepio]] lets you put a card from your hand into your Used Pile, and when with Shmi in battle he lets you put the top card from your Used Pile on to your Reserve Deck which can enable you to get a guaranteed weapon hit, or any other action which requires a high destiny. Combos: Shmi + [[Threepio With His Parts Showing]] = destiny tracking made easy! |combos=* Shmi + [[Threepio With His Parts Showing]] Destiny tracking never so easy.[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Shmi%20Skywalker Scomp: Shmi Skywalker]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). '''Virtual Legacy (AI)''' — [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V) (AI)]] (1281_30ai) |see_also=* [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (AI)]] * [[Alternate Image]] |underlying_card_for=* [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (AI)]] |sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists index] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008) * [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Character: Supreme Chancellor Valorum, Coruscant, R |strategy=By Nick Zubehttps://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/supremechancellorvalorum.html People call Finis Valorum the Bill Clinton of Star Wars. I like to call him the General Zod of SWCCG. If you plan to base your deck around the Galactic Senate, or if you just want to mop the floor with those weenie Dark Side Senators for laughs, [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum]] is your man. With a hefty 5 Politics, Valorum has the highest concentration of political power in the game. Even better, Valorum has excellent stats outside of the Senate, with 4 Ability (all the better to draw battle destiny when alone at the Senate) and a whopping 7 Forfeit. Top it all off with a multiple-use-friendly 3 Destiny, and the Supreme Chancellor's a shoe-in for any deck. But it's his skill in the Senate that makes Valorum a top choice for any deck. While in a Senate majority, he's a one-man [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]], with the power to cancel an opponent's battle destiny at any site, anywhere, any time, for only 1 Force. That's what I like to call sledgehammer politics. And it's all from the safety of the Galactic Senate, where Walkers and Sith Lords are strictly pooh-poohed. Of course, Valorum's power comes with a price. You remember all those "baseless" accusations we heard about in the movie? Well, they're back with a vengeance. As long as your opponent has Force to spend, he can reduce Valorum's Politics infinitely. While this doesn't hinder Valorum when it comes to guerilla "votes" in the Senate, it does make controlling the Senate with him alone a risky proposition. Be prepared to back him up with other political figures, like [[Queen Amidala]]... or a certain future Supreme Chancellor... Combos: cancel two battle destiny? I'm there! Extra power, extra politics, and attrition immunity. No one is safe from Zod – er, Valorum! |combos=* [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum]] + [[General Solo]] + [[Chewbacca]]: cancel two battle destiny? I'm there![https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Supreme%20Chancellor%20Valorum Scomp: Supreme Chancellor Valorum]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). No one is safe from Zod - er, Valorum! |also_known_as=* SCV |has_refs=1 }}

'''Virtual Legacy (AI)''' — [[Yoda, Senior Council Member (V) (AI)]] (1250_57ai) |see_also=* [[Yoda, Senior Council Member (AI)]] * [[Alternate Image]] |sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists index] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008) * [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Character: Yoda, Senior Council Member, Coruscant, R |strategy=By I-Ming Chenhttps://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/yodaseniorcouncilmember.html A new [[Yoda]] persona! [[Yoda]] used to be one of the only "mains" (a main character in the Star Wars film) who did not have a different version of his persona, but that is no more. This new [[Yoda]], as depicted in [[The Phantom Menace]], is an elder of the Council and has great influence over the Jedi. Using 4 Force, he's able to send your Jedi from his location to another one while he's sitting on the Council. Very helpful when you need to send [[Mace Windu]] or [[Plo Koon]] to lend a hand in your battles. Combos: Activate tons of Force. :) Call up the Jedi and then have [[Yoda]] send them out. Keeps your Jedi alive and in play or turn them (like [[Yoda]]) into make-shift [[Mantellian Savrip]]/[[Houjix]]. |combos=* [[Yoda, Senior Council Member]] + [[Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber]] For Force activation.[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Yoda%2C%20Senior%20Council%20Member Scomp: Yoda, Senior Council Member]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). When Maul swings a lightsaber at a Jedi, each weapon destiny draw is +1. If Maul hits a Jedi Master during battle, that Jedi Master is power -3 for remainder of battle. Immune to Clash Of Sabers and attrition < 5. |printings='''Decipher''' — '''this page''' (12_101)
'''Decipher (AI)''' — [[Darth Maul, Young Apprentice (AI)]] (12_102)
'''Decipher (Reflections III foil)''' — [[Darth Maul, Young Apprentice (AI) (Reflections III Foil)|Darth Maul, Young Apprentice (foil)]] |see_also=* [[Darth Maul, Young Apprentice (AI)]] * [[Alternate Image]] |sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists index] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008) * [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Character: Darth Maul, Young Apprentice, Coruscant, R |strategy=By [mailto:joea@decipher.com Joe Alread, Decipher Game Designer]https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/small/darthmaulyoungapprentice.html The [[Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere){{!}}Tatooine]] version of [[Darth Maul]] was unique in the fact that he didn't really care about characters of lesser ability. Now, when [[Maul]] returns Not only will he proceed with the beatdown on a pack of small characters, but [[Maul]] is also equipped to deal with the Light Side Jedi that he hates oh so much. From weapon destiny bonuses to lowering a Jedi's power, [[Maul]] can quickly turn a powerful Jedi into a power two or three, forfeit zero card with ability that's going to get hurt badly! And don't forget the [[Clash Of Sabers]] immunity: you no longer have to be afraid of giving [[Maul]] some backup when he desperately needs it. Combo: The mysterious Sith Master fuels [[Maul]] with total immunity to attrition and extra defense value, making him extremely difficult to get rid of. |combos=* [[Darth Maul, Young Apprentice]] + [[Maul Strikes]][https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Darth%20Maul%2C%20Young%20Apprentice Scomp: Darth Maul, Young Apprentice]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive] * [[Darth Maul, Young Apprentice]] + [[The Phantom Menace]] While present with an opponent's Jedi, [[Maul]] is defense value +2 and immune to attrition. * [[Darth Maul, Young Apprentice]] + [[I Have You Now]] Add one battle destiny (two if Rebel is [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]]) if a Dark Jedi and a Rebel with ability > 2 are involved in the same battle. * [[Darth Maul, Young Apprentice]] + [[Force Field]] Cancels an attempt to target a Dark Jedi with a character weapon. |matching=* [[Maul's Sith Infiltrator]] |matching_weapon=* [[Maul's Double-Bladed Lightsaber]] * [[Maul's Lightsaber]] |also_known_as=* DMYA |personas=* [[Darth Maul (persona)|Maul]] |characteristics=* Dark Jedi |underlying_card_for=* [[Darth Maul, Lone Hunter (C-Slip AI)]] * [[Darth Maul, Young Apprentice (AI)]] |has_refs=1 }}

Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate [[Arica]] to [[Luke (V){{!}}Luke]]'s location. During your control phase, if present at a battleground (and Luke is not), may retrieve 1 Force. Immue to [[Undercover (V){{!}}Undercover]] and attrition < 4. |errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image here is the release-sheet slip that prints it. The current text is [[Arica (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013. * '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Power +1 on Tatooine. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Arica to Luke’s location. During your control phase, if present at a battleground (and Luke is not), may retrieve 1 Force. Immue to Undercover and attrition < 4.”.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 2, slip 01. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive] Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-01-Arica.png]]) prints slip number “01” bottom right. * '''PC-E1''' ([[Arica (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) corrected “Immue” to “Immune”. PC-E1 text: “Power +1 on Tatooine. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Arica to Luke's location. During your control phase, if present at a battleground (and Luke is not), may retrieve 1 Force. Immune to Undercover and attrition < 4.”Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive) The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it. * '''PC-E2''' ([[Arica (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-arica-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)Players Committee card image, file cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/arica.gif; the Internet Archive capture of that folder's directory listing ([https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034634/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Virtual4-Dark], 18 August 2019) gives every file the date 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34 (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock4-Dark/large/arica.gif: “Power +1 on Tatooine. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Arica to Luke's location. During your control phase, if present at a battleground (and Luke is not), may retrieve 1 Force. Immune to Undercover and attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the card-list wording (PC-E1) again, word for word (icons drawn, not written out) except that it spells “Immune” correctly, as the card list does. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 4 set mark) and prints the number “01” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does. * '''PC-E3''' ([[Arica (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side p. 4), official text as of 27 April 2013[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=4, page 4. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]: “Power +1 on Tatooine. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Arica to Luke's location. During your control phase, if present at a battleground (and Luke is not), may retrieve 1 Force. Immue to Undercover and attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC card image (PC-E2) had printed the card-list wording. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1240-1-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number. |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Arica]] (10_31o)

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive] * [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html Virtual Block 4 card list] at res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008202337/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html Internet Archive] * [https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual slips] at starwarsccg.org — Dark: Arica (V). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20240920164229/https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Internet Archive] |hatnote=Other versions of this Legacy card: [[Arica (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Arica (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), [[Arica (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, current). For the Decipher card, see [[Arica]]. }} == Notes == * This card has published mistakes listed on the [[Remaster changes list]] for a future remaster.

This printing and [[Aurra Sing (AI)]] both use her likeness. |see_also=* [[Michonne Bourriague]] * [[Aurra Sing (AI)]] * [[Alternate Image]] |sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists index] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008) * [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Character: Aurra Sing, Tatooine, R |strategy=By I-Ming Chenhttps://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/aurrasing.html The mysterious bounty hunter who made a small cameo during [[The Phantom Menace]] will make more than just a mere cameo to the Star Wars: CCG universe. With 4 ability, she is a no-brainer to any Dark Side deck that battles or relies on main characters. Her game text is interesting since it will depend on the opponent losing a character wielding a lightsaber at the same site. Not too common of an event if your opponent is using only Enhanced characters with built-in weapons, but you'll get a good benefit (i.e. higher immunity to attrition) should the opportunity arise. But enough about her game text. There are a variety of different deck types she will go straight into. For players who are big on playing the popular [[Jabba]]'s Palace effect, Scum And Villiany -- using the [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive{{!}}My Kind Of Scum]] objective (JPSD set) or [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die{{!}}Court Of The Vile Gangster]] objective (Enhanced [[Jabba]]'s Palace set) -- Aurra will be a great addition to the rest of the aliens already in your deck. Even if you don't use Scum And Villany, Aurra is still useful in other decks if you like hunting for bounties. In [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die{{!}}Court Of The Vile Gangster]], she gets forfeit +2 and bypasses [[Goo Nee Tay]]. Since Aurra is a bounty hunter, she will qualify for Agents Of The Black Sun (Reflections II/Expanded Universe set), which will benefit from having another bounty hunter. Combos: [[Aurra Sing]] + [[Quietly Observing]]: Why wait until the opponent just lost a character? Have Aurra sneak up on the opponent and just take it. [[Aurra Sing]] + [[Weapon Levitation]]: Arg... just take the lightsaber. I prefer a straight fight to all this sneaking around. [[Aurra Sing]] + [[Dark Jedi Lightsaber]]: Forget about waiting. Get your own glow stick. Not cheap but you'll be able to add to Force drains and play all the fun interrupts related to lightsabers like [[You Are Beaten]]. |combos=* [[Aurra Sing]] + [[Quietly Observing]][https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Aurra%20Sing Scomp: Aurra Sing]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive] * [[Aurra Sing]] + [[Weapon Levitation]] |rulings=* Stolen lightsabers cannot be transferred to Aurra (unless they are actually capable of deploying on her). |pulled_by=* [[Double Back]] * [[Hondo Ohnaka]] |matching_weapon=* [[Aurra Sing's Blaster Rifle]] |personas=* [[Aurra Sing (persona)|Aurra]] |characteristics=* Force-Sensitive * Black Sun agent * bounty hunter * female |underlying_card_for=* [[Aurra Sing With Blaster Rifle (AI)]] * [[Aurra Sing (AI)]] |has_refs=1 }}

Once per game, during your move phase, may fire her weapon at a Jedi; hit target is lost. The date is a bulk upload of the whole folder, so the image may have been made earlier, but the wiki orders versions by the date each document was published (Bill, 11 November 2026). It is a version of its own even though its words repeat an earlier text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version). The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture, and prints the slip number “02” at bottom right. * '''PC-E3''' ([[Aurra Sing (V) (Errata 3)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 4)[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Once per game, during your move phase, may fire her weapon at a Jedi; hit target is lost. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' Nothing in the words: the Master List prints the same words as the card image. The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). As the latest publication it is the current text. The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip is the lower part of the card, as on the release sheet; it prints no slip number at bottom right (the release-sheet slip has “02”). {{Card |title=Aurra Sing (V) |display_title=Aurra Sing |margin_note=•Aurra Sing (V) |underlying_card=[[Aurra Sing]] |card_uid=1250_2 |gemp_id=1250_2 |slip=02 |image=VB5-02-Aurra_Sing-PC-E3-master-list.png |concept_credit=Original concept by Sam Tashima, North Dakota States 2005 |side=Dark |type=Character |subtype=Alien |subtype_link=Alien |set=Virtual Block 5 |publisher=[[Players Committee]] |era=[[Virtual Legacy]] |rarity=R |rarity_link=Rarity#Rare |uniqueness=Unique |destiny=1 |power=4 |ability=4 |deploy=4 |forfeit=3 |personas=* [[Aurra Sing (persona)|Aurra]] |lore=Bounty hunter. Former student of the Force. After failing her Jedi training, Aurra became known for hunting down and killing Jedi Knights. |icons=[[Warrior]] [[Episode I]] [[Tatooine]] |version_label=virtual |version_code=PC-E3 |set_band=Virtual |prev= |next= |game_text=Once during opponent's activate phase, may relocate Aurra to same site as a Jedi. Once per game, during your move phase, may fire her weapon at a Jedi; hit target is lost. Immune to attrition < 4. |errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Aurra Sing (V)]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image here is the Master List slip ([[:File:VB5-02-Aurra_Sing-PC-E3-master-list.png]]). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; differences that come only from a document's medium (icons written out in words on the card list, straight quotes, credit lines) are not changes. * '''Original''' ([[Aurra Sing (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Once during opponent's activate phase, may relocate Aurra to same site as a Jedi. Once per game, during your move phase, may fire her weapon at a Jedi; hit target is lost. Immune to attrition < 4.”.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 2, slip 02. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive] The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “02” at bottom right. * '''PC-E1''' ([[Aurra Sing (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “relocate Aurra to same site as a Jedi” to “relocate Aurra to a site where opponent has a Jedi”. PC-E1 text: “Once during opponent's activate phase, may relocate Aurra to a site where opponent has a Jedi. Once per game, during your move phase, may fire her weapon at a Jedi; hit target is lost. Immune to attrition < 4.”Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive) The card list is a text page: no slip, picture or slip number, and icons are written out in words. * '''PC-E2''' ([[Aurra Sing (V) (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-aurrasing-pre.gif]]) prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Once during opponent's activate phase, may relocate Aurra to same site as a Jedi. Once per game, during your move phase, may fire her weapon at a Jedi; hit target is lost. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' “relocate Aurra to same site as a Jedi” again, for the card list's “relocate Aurra to a site where opponent has a Jedi”. The image is undated. The PC's image folder (Virtual5-Dark) lists the file, with every other file in it, as last modified on 25 February 2013[https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034650/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Apache directory listing of Virtual5-Dark/large] (Internet Archive, captured 18 August 2019): every file in the folder last modified 25 February 2013; the captures of the image in 2018 and 2019 have the same bytes as the file on the wiki. Research note R6, 11 November 2026.; it is dated by that upload date, after the card list and before the Master List. The date is a bulk upload of the whole folder, so the image may have been made earlier, but the wiki orders versions by the date each document was published (Bill, 11 November 2026). It is a version of its own even though its words repeat an earlier text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version). The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture, and prints the slip number “02” at bottom right. * '''PC-E3''' (this page): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 4)[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=4, page 4. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive] prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Once during opponent's activate phase, may relocate Aurra to same site as a Jedi. Once per game, during your move phase, may fire her weapon at a Jedi; hit target is lost. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' Nothing in the words: the Master List prints the same words as the card image. The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). As the latest publication it is the current text. The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip is the lower part of the card, as on the release sheet; it prints no slip number at bottom right (the release-sheet slip has “02”). GEMP's current card plays this text: Aurra may relocate to the same site as any Jedi (play change from the card-list text, approved by Bill, 11 November 2026). |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Aurra Sing]] (11_51)

{{Card |title=Darth Maul |card_uid=11_54 |image=Tat-D-darthmaul-decipher-archive.jpg |hires_image=Tat-D-darthmaul-hires.webp |side=Dark |type=Character |subtype=Sith |subtype_link=Sith |set=Tatooine |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |rarity=R |rarity_link=Rarity#Rare |uniqueness=Unique |destiny=1 |power=7 |ability=6 |deploy=8 |forfeit=8 |icons=[[Pilot]] [[Warrior]] |version_label=printed |set_band=Decipher |prev=Daroe |next=Dud Bolt's Podracer |lore=Apprentice to Darth Sidious. Sent to capture Queen Amidala on Tatooine. Full of anger and fury as a child. Sidious used Maul's pent-up rage to train him in the ways of the Sith. |game_text=Deploys -2 to Tatooine. During your control phase may lose 1 Force to duel opponent's Jedi present. Both players draw 2 destiny. Loser is lost. Unless opponent's character of ability > 3 here, opponent's total ability here = 0. Immune to attrition < 5. |printings='''Decipher''' — '''this page''' (11_54)
'''Decipher (AI)''' — [[Darth Maul (AI)]] (11_55)
'''Decipher (Reflections III foil)''' — [[Darth Maul (AI) (Reflections III Foil)|Darth Maul (foil)]] |see_also=* [[Darth Maul (AI)]] * [[Alternate Image]] |underlying_card_for=* [[Darth Maul (AI)]] |sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists index] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008) * [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Character: Darth Maul, Tatooine, R |strategy=By Martin Arlthttps://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/darthmaul.html [[Darth Maul]] has loyalty only to [[Darth Sidious]] and the Dark Side of the Force. This unwavering devotion is represented by [[Maul]]'s unique icon, which is neither alien nor Imperial. [[Maul]]'s high deploy cost is comfortably offset by the reduced deploy to [[Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere){{!}}Tatooine]], and is reduced even further if he deploys to the [[Tatooine: Hutt Trade Route (Desert){{!}}Desert]] Landing Site. [[Maul]]'s built-in dueling text seems risky with both players drawing the same number of destiny, but adding a duel destiny with a card like [[Focused Attack]] and setting up a high destiny draw with [[Maul's Electrobinoculars]] can quickly swing the duel in the Dark Jedi's favor. Of course, [[Maul]] is incredibly focused thanks to his thirst for revenge against the Jedi. As a result, most characters that aren't Force Attuned are beneath his notice. This is reflected in his gametext that kicks in if none of the Light Side characters at his location have ability of 4 or greater. At such a location, the Light Side's total ability is zero. In other words, the Light Side has no presence at this location, and thus cannot battle or be battled. In addition, it means that the Light Side will need to come up with an ability 4 or higher character in order to block [[Maul]]'s Force drains. Meanwhile, [[Maul]] with his Lightsaber and [[Sniper]] can gradually whittle away the Light Side's characters at his site. When combined with Sith Probe Droids and [[I Will Find Them Quickly, Master]], [[Maul]] becomes an Amidala-capturing machine, reflecting his other major focus in [[The Phantom Menace]]: to locate and detain the Queen. |combos=* [[Darth Maul]] + [[Maul's Sith Infiltrator]] at [[Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere){{!}}Tatooine]] system: Deploys for 6, it's [[Maul]] -2 and -3 on his ship.[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Darth%20Maul Scomp: Darth Maul]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive] * [[Darth Maul]] + [[Maul Strikes]] * [[Darth Maul]] + [[The Phantom Menace]] While present with an opponent's Jedi, [[Maul]] is defense value +2 and immune to attrition. * [[Darth Maul]] + [[I Have You Now]] Add one battle destiny (two if Rebel is [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]]) if a Dark Jedi and a Rebel with ability > 2 are involved in the same battle. * [[Darth Maul]] + [[Force Field]] Cancels an attempt to target a Dark Jedi with a character weapon. |rulings=* The loser of the duel is the character with the lower total. * If the duel totals are tied, there is no winner and no loser. * If a character of ability > 3 is excluded and this causes [[Maul]]'s text to make Dark control the location, the excluded character is still active for the purposes of Objective flip conditions (e.g. [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation{{!}}Quiet Mining Colony]]) and for the purposes of preventing cards like [[Haven]] from leaving table. |matching=* [[Maul's Sith Infiltrator]] |matching_weapon=* [[Maul's Double-Bladed Lightsaber]] * [[Maul's Lightsaber]] |also_known_as=* Tat Maul |personas=* [[Darth Maul (persona)|Maul]] |characteristics=* Dark Jedi |has_refs=1 }}
